index.title: Electronic Catalog Maker — Interactive Image Catalogs
index.hero.title: Turn any image into an interactive catalog.
index.hero.text: Add clickable hotspots to photos and diagrams. Attach product details, part numbers, and links — all in one catalog file.
index.demo.title: See how it works
index.demo.intro: Select a marker or use the arrows to explore item details. Use Fit to see the whole image.
index.demo.hint.livingRoom: Select a marker to open a close-up of that piece — its details and Buy are there. ⌂ takes you back to the room.
index.demo.hint.grid: Select a number on a tile to see the product’s details and Buy. The list at the top switches between groups.
index.demo.hint.gridComposer: Have photos and a spreadsheet? Grid Composer builds a grid like this for you →
index.demo.hint.booking: Select a service to see what it is and how it goes — “Book” opens the booking calendar. ⌂ takes you back to the list.
index.demo.note: Buy opens our demo store checkout, where every item costs $0.
index.demo.noteProtected: Demo password: stool-2026. Type it on the lock screen below; the cover and title are visible without it.
index.demo.noteBooking: “Book” opens a demo booking calendar — appointments made there are not real.
index.demo.steps: Build your own: add an image → mark the details with hotspots → save the catalog file and open it in Viewer.
index.demo.embed: Put it on your own site: the demo above is the embeddable widget itself — one <script> tag and one <ecm-viewer> line put it on your page.
index.demo.embed.sample: See it on a sample store site →
index.demo.agent: Ready for AI assistants: in a browser with WebMCP (still experimental), an assistant can search the catalog and show you an item. It opens a store page only after you confirm.
index.demo.noscript: The live demo needs JavaScript — use “Open full demo” above.
index.who.title: Who it's for
index.who.parts.title: Parts and equipment
index.who.parts.text: Exploded views linked to part numbers, descriptions and a Buy button — the number on the diagram matches the row in the table.
index.who.furniture.title: Furniture and home goods
index.who.furniture.text: Shop the look: tap a piece in a room photo to open it with its details and a Buy button. Or lay out the whole range as a product grid.
index.who.furniture.composer: Build a grid from your photos →
index.who.teaching.title: Teaching and learning
index.who.teaching.text: Explorable diagrams for lessons and class projects — no student accounts, no cloud. See the schools page →
index.who.fitness.title: Gyms and fitness
index.who.fitness.text: Pick a muscle group, find the machine, see how to set it up and print a workout — no app, no account.
index.who.booking.title: Services and booking
index.who.booking.text: A photo list of your services: a client picks one, reads how it goes and taps “Book” — your booking calendar opens.
index.who.quiz.title: Tests and self-check
index.who.quiz.text: Answer options sit on the picture — tap one and it turns green or red, with a running score.
index.who.protected.title: Paid and members-only catalogs
index.who.protected.text: Sell a guide or a course, or share some catalogs with everyone and keep others for the people you give the password to. One password per file — no accounts, no server; anyone who has the password can open it. You create the protected copy in the Editor.

index.toolset.alt: Your store, photos or any picture become one .ecatm catalog, which reaches any phone or PC through a website, a QR code or the Catalog Server.

index.benefits.title: Built around your catalog files
index.benefits.free.title: Free, no subscription
index.benefits.free.text: The apps are free and open source (MIT). No accounts, no plans.
index.benefits.file.title: Your catalog is one file
index.benefits.file.text: Images, hotspots and data live together in a single .ecatm file on your device. It goes nowhere unless you share it.
index.benefits.photos.title: Photos and diagrams
index.benefits.photos.text: Put hotspots on any image — a room photo, a parts diagram, an anatomy chart — and link images together: tap the sofa in the room to open its close-up.
index.benefits.store.title: Links to your own store
index.benefits.store.text: Point items at any online store you already use. There's no marketplace or checkout of ours in between.
index.benefits.offline.title: Works offline after you first open it
index.benefits.offline.text: After you first open the apps on a computer, tablet or phone, they are cached in your browser and keep working without a connection.
index.benefits.live.title: Live editing and catalog sharing, only if you want them
index.benefits.live.text: Two optional apps you run yourself: the Collaboration Server for live editing together, and the Catalog Server for sharing a folder of catalogs on your network or the internet. Everything else works without them.

schools.title: Electronic Catalog Maker for Schools
schools.tagline: Got a diagram? In a few minutes it's a click-around class project — no accounts to create, no cloud to trust, nothing to pay for.
schools.points.privacy.title: No accounts, no student data
schools.points.privacy.text: A catalog is just a file stored on your own device. There's no cloud database behind it, and students don't need to sign up for anything.
schools.points.group.title: Real-time group projects
schools.points.group.text: A whole class can label one diagram together, live, on the same file at once — using the free, optional collaboration server.
schools.points.year.title: Still works next year
schools.points.year.text: A file saved in September opens exactly the same in June — no renewal, no expiring account, no breaking update to worry about.
schools.points.free.title: Free apps, no subscription
schools.points.free.text: The same Editor and Viewer everyone else uses — just switched to "Education" mode, which relabels Buy/Cart into Learn more/Collection.
schools.points.quiz.title: Self-check quizzes
schools.points.quiz.text: Turn the same diagram into a self-check quiz: students tap an answer, it turns green or red at once with a short explanation, and they can print their results. Practice, not a proctored exam.
schools.demo.title: 🧫 Try it — an animal cell, ready to click around
schools.demo.hint: This demo catalog has "Education" mode switched on: notice the toolbar says "📚 Collection" instead of "🛒 Cart", and each part says "Learn more" instead of "Buy" — same app, same file format, just relabeled for a classroom.
schools.quiz.title: 📝 Try a quiz — eight questions about the cell
schools.quiz.hint: Tap an answer: it turns green or red at once, with a short explanation. Question 7 needs two answers. The score builds up as you go. It's a self-check for practice — the answers live inside the file, so it isn't a proctored exam.
schools.build.title: ✏️ Build your own
schools.build.text: Drop in a diagram — a cell, an engine, a map, a machine — place a few hotspots, and it's a class project. Works offline after you first open it on a computer, tablet or phone, and keeps working after the bell rings on the last day of school.

toolset.viewer.s: on any phone, tablet or PC

types.heading: Electronic Catalog Maker — what a catalog can be
types.alt: Catalog types in four levels. Navigation: one picture, a picture list or a home picture. Picture: one item, a photo with hotspots, an exploded view or a tile grid. Details: a table or a card. Action: buy, learn more, exercise, book, answer or no action.
types.title: What a catalog can be
types.ex.s: Live demos: one pick from levels 1, 2 and 4 (every catalog has both the table and the card).
types.plus: with the plus, picks collect in a list (cart, collection, workout, picks); without it the action happens right away. It is a setting of the catalog.
